figurative_meaning_bn: আয়ু অল্প হবে- এই কামনায় গালিবিশেষ
figurative_meaning_en: A special curse wishing for a short life
similar_in_english: Curse you to an early grave
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুই এমন বদমাশি করলে অল্পেয়ে তোর!
example_sentences_in_english: Hey old Narad, may your life be short!
If you act so mischievously, may your life be short!
history: References Narad Muni, a figure from Hindu mythology, often depicted as an elderly sage in Bengali folklore
note: Dialectal variation common in rural Bengal; used in abusive contexts to invoke mythological figures
